We see the CORLEONE FAMILY gathered in the living room, celebrating the wedding of CONNIE CORLEONE and CARLO RIZZI. We see TOM HAGEN, the Corleone family's consigliere, and FREDERICO "FREDO" CORLEONE, Don Vito's weak and timid son.

( stroking his chin )
I'm gonna make him an offer he can't refuse.

EXT. JACK WOLTZ'S MANSION - NIGHT

We see JACK WOLTZ, the head of the studio, talking to TOM HAGEN.

JACK
( arrogant )

TOM
( calm )
I'm afraid you're going to have to give it to him, Mr. Woltz.

JACK
( laughing )
Or what? You'll kill me?

TOM
( smiling )
No, Mr. Woltz. I'm a lawyer. I don't kill people. But I do have a lot of influence.

INT. JACK WOLTZ'S BEDROOM - NIGHT

We see JACK WOLTZ, waking up to find the head of his prize horse, KHARTOUM, in his bed.

JACK

We see DON VITO CORLEONE, sitting in his garden, talking to TOM HAGEN.

DON VITO
( stroking his chin )
I'm getting old, Tom. I need someone to take care of the family.

TOM
( loyal )
I'll take care of the family, Godfather.

DON VITO
( smiling )
I know you will, Tom. But I need someone with more... power.
